stories.title: Brain Lock Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define MongoDB schema and service-level contract for Brain locks including lock_id, owner_id, created_at, expires_at (TTL), status, and recovery metadata. Ensure compatibility with existing Mongo utilities and Brain runner usage.

stories.title: TTL Expiration and Renewal Core Logic
stories.description: Implement core backend logic for lock expiration using TTL semantics and renewal rules. Ensure expired locks are safely invalidated and renewal updates expiration atomically to prevent race conditions.

stories.title: Lock Recovery and Conflict Resolution Workflows
stories.description: Implement recovery logic for abandoned or expired locks, including safe takeover rules, ownership validation, and conflict resolution when multiple processes attempt acquisition. Include safeguards aligned with single-writer governance.

stories.title: Lock Mechanism Test Suite
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, TTL expiration, renewal, conflict scenarios, and recovery workflows. Validate atomicity, race condition handling, and failure modes.
